story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Every voucher event (create/edit/post/reverse/unpost/import) generates audit log entry with: JSON snapshot (before/after), SHA-256 diff hash, user ID/role, device/IP (if available). 2. Mass/batch actions log aggregated entry with: voucher IDs list, action stats (success/failure counts), start/end timestamp, details summary. 3. "Voucher history" view displays colored field-by-field diff (green=added, red=removed, yellow=changed) and plain English summary (e.g., "Voucher posted by John Doe on 2025-11-13"). 4. Full audit logs exportable as PDF (with hash watermark) or JSON; export includes all events for voucher with cryptographic hashes. 5. Admin/audit dashboard displays mass actions, blocked operations, suspicious patterns (e.g., multiple reversal attempts); alerts deferred to post-MVP (logged only).

docs.doc: Story definition: As an auditor or admin, I want a cryptographically hashed, tamper-proof log of every change to vouchers, so all edits and actions are legally defensible and reviewable. Acceptance criteria cover JSON snapshots, SHA-256 diff hashes, user/role/device/IP capture, mass action logging, colored field-by-field diff display, plain English summaries, PDF/JSON export with hash watermarks, and admin audit dashboard.

docs.doc: Audit Service Enhanced: AuditService has logFraudDetection() and logBlockedAttempt() methods - extend this pattern for voucher lifecycle events. Audit Log Entity: AuditLog entity exists with changes (JSON) and metadata (JSON) fields - use these for storing before/after snapshots and batch action stats. Company Scoping Pattern: All operations use CompanyContext.getCompanyId() for company isolation - apply same pattern for audit log queries. Error Handling: Audit logging wrapped in try-catch blocks to not break main flow - follow same pattern for voucher lifecycle audit logging. JSON Handling: System uses JsonNode (Jackson) for JSON fields in entities - use ObjectMapper to serialize voucher entities to JSON snapshots.

Audit logging patterns established for posting, unposting, and reversal operations. VoucherPostingService logs posting events, VoucherUnpostingService logs unposting events, VoucherReversalService logs reversal events. All audit logging uses AuditService interface. Company scoping pattern via CompanyScopeAspect. RBAC enforcement using @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT','ADMIN','CFO')").
Audit trail: Immutable append-only logs. Cryptographic hashing for audit log integrity. Encryption in transit: HTTPS/TLS. Encryption at rest: Database-level encryption.
Audit: audit_logs (id, entity_type, entity_id, action, user_id, timestamp, changes, ...). All audit logs are company-scoped via company_id filtering.

story-context.constraints: - Audit log immutability: Audit logs must be immutable (append-only) and cryptographically hashed for tamper-proof verification. No updates or deletes allowed on audit log entries. - SHA-256 diff hash: Calculate SHA-256 hash of JSON diff between before/after snapshots. Hash must be stored in AuditLog.metadata JSON field as "diffHash" key. - JSON snapshot format: Before/after snapshots stored in AuditLog.changes JSON field with structure: { before: { ...voucher fields... }, after: { ...voucher fields... } }. Use ObjectMapper to serialize voucher entity to JSON. - Company scoping: All audit log queries must be scoped to current company via CompanyContext.getCompanyId(). Only return audit logs for vouchers in current company. - RBAC enforcement: Audit log access requires proper role-based permissions. Auditors and admins can view audit logs. Regular users cannot access audit logs. - Non-blocking audit: Audit logging should not block main business logic. Wrap audit logging in try-catch blocks or use async execution to ensure main flow continues even if audit logging fails. - Field-level diff generation: Compare JSON snapshots field-by-field to detect changes. Return diff structure: { field: { before: value, after: value, changeType: 'added'|'removed'|'changed' } }. - Plain English summary: Generate human-readable summaries like "Voucher posted by {user} on {date}", "Voucher edited: {field} changed from {old} to {new}". Store in AuditLog.metadata as "summary" key. - Batch action logging: For mass/batch actions, log single aggregated entry with voucher IDs list, success/failure counts, start/end timestamps, and summary in AuditLog.metadata JSON field. - PDF export hash watermark: Embed SHA-256 hash of PDF content in footer/header of PDF export. Use iText or Apache PDFBox for PDF generation. - JSON export format: Export all audit log entries as JSON array with cryptographic hashes included in each entry. - Suspicious pattern detection: Log suspicious patterns (multiple reversal attempts, rapid-fire edits, bulk operations) in AuditLog.metadata with "suspiciousPattern" flag. Defer alert sending (email, notifications) to post-MVP. - Database indexes: Add index on (entity_type, entity_id, company_id, created_at) for efficient history queries. Add index on (company_id, action, created_at) for audit dashboard queries. - Device/IP capture: Extract IP address from HttpServletRequest.getRemoteAddr() and user agent from HttpServletRequest.getHeader("User-Agent"). Store in AuditLog.ipAddress and AuditLog.userAgent fields. - User/role capture: Extract user ID from SecurityContext or CompanyContext, role from User entity. Store in AuditLog.userId and AuditLog.actorRole fields.

tests.standards: Unit tests use JUnit 5 and Mockito. Integration tests use @SpringBootTest with IntegrationTest base class and TestContainers for PostgreSQL. Frontend tests use Vitest, Testing Library, and jsdom. Coverage targets: 70% for backend business logic, 60% for frontend components. All audit logging must be tested with before/after snapshots, SHA-256 diff hash calculation, and company scoping.

test.description: Test JSON snapshot generation: verify before/after snapshots are correctly serialized from voucher entity using ObjectMapper. Test SHA-256 diff hash calculation: verify hash is consistent and tamper-proof (same diff produces same hash, different diff produces different hash). Test user ID/role capture: verify userId and actorRole are correctly extracted from SecurityContext and User entity. Test device/IP capture: verify IP address and user agent are extracted from HttpServletRequest.

Test batch action logging: verify aggregated entry contains voucher IDs list, success/failure counts, start/end timestamps, and summary in AuditLog.metadata JSON field. Test batch action stats DTO: verify BatchActionStats contains successCount, failureCount, totalCount fields.

Test field-by-field diff generation: verify correct change detection (added/removed/changed fields). Test plain English summary generation: verify summaries are human-readable and accurate (e.g., 'Voucher posted by John Doe on 2025-11-13'). Test colored diff display: verify green highlight for added fields, red highlight for removed fields, yellow highlight for changed fields in VoucherHistoryView component. Test filter/search functionality: verify filtering by action type, user, date range works correctly.

Test JSON export: verify JSON export structure includes all audit log entries with cryptographic hashes. Test PDF export: verify PDF generation includes hash watermark in footer/header. Test PDF hash watermark: verify SHA-256 hash of PDF content is embedded correctly. Test export RBAC: verify only users with export permissions can export audit logs.

Test suspicious pattern detection: verify multiple reversal attempts, rapid-fire edits, bulk operations are logged with suspiciousPattern flag in AuditLog.metadata. Test admin audit dashboard: verify mass actions, blocked operations, suspicious patterns are displayed (deferred to post-MVP for UI, test logging only).

Integration test: GET /api/v1/vouchers/{id}/history returns paginated list of audit log entries with field-level diffs. GET /api/v1/vouchers/{id}/history/export?format=json returns JSON export with hashes. GET /api/v1/vouchers/{id}/history/export?format=pdf returns PDF export with hash watermark. Test company scoping: verify cross-company access blocked. Test RBAC: verify unauthorized users cannot access history.

Frontend test: VoucherHistoryView displays audit log entries in chronological order. VoucherHistoryView shows colored field-by-field diff (green/red/yellow). VoucherHistoryView displays plain English summaries. VoucherHistoryView filter/search works correctly. VoucherHistoryView integrates into VoucherFormPage as History tab or button.
